disposition_reason: Original AAS measurements of lead, cadmium, chromium and nickel (and potassium bromate) in 20 bread samples from Kaduna bakeries, reported as overall means.

study.design: Market survey of bread from bakeries
study.market: Industrial and small-scale bakeries across Kaduna North, Kaduna South, Chikun and Igabi LGAs, Kaduna Metropolis, Nigeria
study.method: AAS for metals (digestion not described); UV-visible spectrophotometry for potassium bromate
study.qa: Triplicate analyses; 'standard reference materials were used' but no results reported

findings.notes: Results section header says 'Mean ± SD' but no SD is printed. Basis not stated.

unresolved: Potassium bromate (mean 0.022 mg/kg, range 0.015-0.030) is not a metal and was not recorded as a finding.
No per-bakery, per-LGA or industrial vs small-scale values are printed although the paper says it compares them.
The published text keeps template placeholders ('SPSS (Version XX)', 'Include:' list in the risk section, blank cancer-risk thresholds); health-risk results are not reported.
Digestion method, LODs and collection dates are not reported.
